title: Table
description: A feature-rich data table with sorting, filtering, selection, expansion, pinning, inline editing, infinite scroll, and responsive mobile card layout.

columns.description: TanStack ColumnDef array defining table columns.

loading.description: Whether the table is in a loading state showing shimmer rows.

showHeader.description: Whether to show the table header row.

pinnedColumns.description: Column IDs to pin to the left side.

onPinnedColumnsChange.description: (pinnedColumns: string[]) => void — Fires when a pin button is pressed, with the full new `pinnedColumns` array: the column appended when pinned, removed when unpinned.

pinnableColumns.description: Column IDs that are allowed to be pinned.

maxPinnedColumns.description: Maximum number of columns that can be pinned simultaneously.

onCursorPositionChange.description: (position: { x: number; y: number } | null) => void — Fires as the pointer moves over the table, with its position relative to the root; `null` when it leaves.
onCursorPositionChange.x-tsType: ((position: { x: number; y: number; } | null) => void) | undefined

onHeaderHoverChange.description: (isOverHeader: boolean) => void — Fires with whether the pointer is over the header row.

emptyContent.description: React.ReactNode — Content shown when the table has no data.

aria-label.description: The grid's accessible name; pinned parts append " - Pinned columns" and so on.

aria-labelledby.description: Ids of the elements that name the region; wins over `aria-label`.

aria-describedby.description: Ids of the elements that describe the region.

caption.description: Accessible caption rendered as a visually hidden <caption> element.

getRowId.description: (row: TData) => string — Function to derive a unique row ID.

selectedRowId.description: ID of the currently selected row (single selection).

onRowClick.description: (rowData: TData) => void — Callback fired when a row is clicked.

onRowHover.description: (rowIndex: number | null, rowRef?: React.RefObject) => void — Callback fired when a row is hovered.
onRowHover.x-tsType: ((rowIndex: number | null, rowRef?: RefObject<HTMLTableRowElement> | undefined) => void) | undefined

floatingActions.description: React.ReactNode — Floating action elements displayed on row hover.

floatingActionsHovered.description: Whether the floating actions area is being hovered.

popupOpen.description: Set while a popup opened from `floatingActions` is open, so the hovered row and cursor tracking hold still.

maxWidth.description: Maximum width of the table container.

maxHeight.description: Maximum height of the table container.

minHeight.description: Minimum height of the table container.

hideVerticalScrollbar.description: Whether to hide the vertical scrollbar.

hideHorizontalScrollbar.description: Whether to hide the horizontal scrollbar.

stickyHeader.description: Whether the header row sticks to the top when scrolling.

classes.description: CSS class overrides for table sub-elements.

style.description: Inline styles applied to the root container.

pinIcon.description: ReactNode — Replaces the pin button's glyph. Rendered as given; also used for pinned columns unless `pinnedIcon` is set.

pinnedIcon.description: ReactNode — Replaces the pin button's glyph on a pinned column. Rendered as given.

shimmerCount.description: Number of shimmer rows to display while loading.

className.description: CSS class for the root element.

onSortingChange.description: (sorting: SortingState) => void — Callback when sorting state changes.

manualSorting.description: When true, sorting is handled server-side.

onSelectedRowIdsChange.description: (selectedRowIds: string[]) => void — Fires with the new `selectedRowIds` when selection changes.

selectAllMode.description: Whether select-all selects current page or all rows.

globalFilter.description: Global filter value for searching across all columns.

onGlobalFilterChange.description: (value: string) => void — Callback when global filter changes.

onColumnFiltersChange.description: (filters: ColumnFiltersState) => void — Callback when column filters change.

filterableColumns.description: Map of column ID to filter options configuration.
filterableColumns.x-tsType: Record<string, { options: { label: string; value: string; }[]; multi?: boolean | undefined; }> | undefined

renderFilterIcon.description: (state: { active: boolean; className: string }) => ReactNode — Draws the column filter button's icon. `active` is true while the column has a filter applied.
renderFilterIcon.x-tsType: ((state: { active: boolean; className: string; }) => ReactNode) | undefined

renderColumnFilter.description: (columnId: string, currentValues: string[], setValues: (values: string[]) => void) => ReactNode — Custom filter dropdown renderer.
renderColumnFilter.x-tsType: ((columnId: string, currentValues: string[], setValues: (values: string[]) => void) => ReactNode) | undefined

onExpandedRowIdsChange.description: (expandedRowIds: string[]) => void — Fires with the new `expandedRowIds` when a row expands or collapses.

renderExpandedRow.description: (row: TData) => ReactNode — Render function for expanded row content.

renderExpandIcon.description: (state: { expanded: boolean; className: string }) => ReactNode — Draws the row expand button's icon, which can change with `expanded`.
renderExpandIcon.x-tsType: ((state: { expanded: boolean; className: string; }) => ReactNode) | undefined

expandColumnPosition.description: Which end of the row the expand column sits at. `start` is the first column.

expandOnRowClick.description: Make the entire row clickable to toggle expansion.

columnVisibility.description: Controlled column visibility map (column ID to boolean).

onColumnVisibilityChange.description: (visibility: Record<string, boolean>) => void — Callback when column visibility changes.

stripedClassName.description: Custom CSS class for striped rows.

pinnedRightColumns.description: Column IDs to pin to the right side.

editable.description: Enable inline cell editing: double-click a cell, or press Enter or F2 on it.

onCellEdit.description: (rowId: string, columnId: string, value: unknown) => void — Callback when a cell value is edited.
onCellEdit.x-tsType: ((rowId: string, columnId: string, value: unknown) => void) | undefined

resizable.description: Enable column resizing via drag handles.

onColumnSizingChange.description: (sizing: ColumnSizingState) => void — Callback when column sizing changes.

manualPagination.description: When true, pagination is handled server-side.

manualFiltering.description: When true, filtering is handled server-side.

columnOrder.description: Controlled column order (array of column IDs).

onColumnOrderChange.description: (order: string[]) => void — Callback when column order changes.

onRowReorder.description: (fromIndex: number, toIndex: number) => void — Callback when a row is reordered.

dragColumnPosition.description: Which end of the row the drag handle column sits at.

footerContent.description: React.ReactNode — Custom footer content for <tfoot>. Rows (a <tr>, a fragment of <tr>s, or an array of them) render directly in <tfoot>; anything else (text, or any other element) is placed in one full-width row.

onContextMenu.description: (event: React.MouseEvent, row: TData) => void — Callback on right-click of a row.
onContextMenu.x-tsType: ((event: MouseEvent<Element, MouseEvent>, row: TData) => void) | undefined

copyOnClick.description: Enable single-click cell copy to clipboard.

onCellCopy.description: (value: string, rowId: string, columnId: string) => void — Callback after a cell value is copied.
onCellCopy.x-tsType: ((value: string, rowId: string, columnId: string) => void) | undefined

onLoadMore.description: () => void — Callback when user scrolls near the bottom.

hasMore.description: Whether there is more data to load.

loadingMore.description: Whether more data is currently being loaded.

infiniteEndContent.description: React.ReactNode — Content shown when all data is loaded.

responsiveBreakpoint.description: Viewport width below which the table renders as card layout.

renderMobileCard.description: (row: TData) => ReactNode — Render function for mobile card layout.

groupBy.description: Column IDs to group rows by.

onGroupByChange.description: (groupBy: string[]) => void — Callback when group-by columns change.

showSearch.description: Show a built-in search bar above the table.

searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text for the search bar.

searchIconPosition.description: Which end of the search field the icon sits at, or `none`.

renderCheckboxIcon.description: (state: { checked: boolean; indeterminate: boolean; className?: string }) => ReactNode — Draws the multi-row selection checkboxes in place of the native box.
renderCheckboxIcon.x-tsType: ((state: { checked: boolean; indeterminate: boolean; className?: string | undefined; }) => ReactNode) | undefined

checkboxColor.description: Simple color customization for the default checkbox.

dragHandleIcon.description: ReactNode — Replaces the drag handle's glyph. Rendered as given.

searchIcon.description: ReactNode — Replaces the search field's magnifier. Rendered inside a box carrying `classes.searchIcon`, which positions it in the field.

onSearchClear.description: () => void — Callback when the search clear button is clicked.

loadingMoreContent.description: React.ReactNode — Custom content for the loading more indicator.
